author: pope_panda
body:
This is a tournament map I just recently finished (with some help).
I wanted a flat and simplistic map, to show off the teams strategies and skill in nebula!

Builders: pope_panda
Helpers: ElectraXdroid

Images: http://imgur.com/a/VuJPP
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/81ijk5pj6zc9dt0/Panda1.rar 
YML: (Been told TM CTW will get their YML done before the tourney)
Server provider: ScriptingLyfe

Feedback is welcomed

This will only be used in the tournament, not public matches

replies.author: ksch
replies.body: This will not play anywhere close to how deepwind plays. Just because it looks the same doesnt mean they will play anywhere close to the same. Deepwind is extremly different. Deepwind in ocn's tourney a few months ago was about getting control about water and allowing it to be used for the few buckets you can get in spawn. Deepwind had no way of getting better armor except for the weak wool gear box. Deepwind was all trying to sneak attack defenders when no matter what you had pretty much the same gear. With the blocks of shit to make armor it wont play anything like deepwind. I played deepwind in an ocn tourney about a year ago (roth), and no other ctw map will play anywhere near how it did. Please dont say a map would play like another when you have never seen or played said map in a tourney kthnxbye /endrant
